title: So Cute
text: So Cute. This is so cute and made really well...I use it in the bathroom for fairly small items because its not very big baskets and its woven tight so lays pretty flat....its not going to hold a large amount of items

product_metadata.title: PASANBA Over the Door Hanging Basket, 3-Tiers Wall Hanging Storage Basket, Woven Cotton Rope Wall Mount Hanging Organizer, Decorative Hanging Basket for Living Room, Bathroom, Kitchen, Bedroom, Jute
features: 🌻【Stylish & Efficient Storage】 This hanging storage organizers keeps things neat and organized and stores all your essentials in one convenient place so you can quickly find what you need. Simply hang it on the door or hang it on the wall. Wide spaces makes storing and retrieving a breeze.

🌻【Durable Natural Materials】Our tiered hanging baskets are made of premium natural cotton rope, tightly woven together to form sturdy, lovely baskets that are stylish and reliable. 8.26 inch in deep and 14.37 inch in wide, each basket can hold up to 8 pounds.

🌻【Detachable Design】The 3-tier over the door organizer basket can be detached into 3 separate baskets so you could possibly fit these stylish baskets depending on your space. You can manually press the bottom to adjust the shape of the basket，which will be placed on the desktop smoothly.

🌻【Upgraded Hanging Methods】 This over door hanging basket with two hooks, Which can Easy to hang on the door, wall, closet, etc. It has two hanging methods. The first method is two holes on the back and the second method is two holes on the side. The design is to avoid the falling of objects placed inside when you hang the hanging basket on the door or anywhere.

🌻【Functional & Space-Saving Design】Maximize unused space and create additional storage where you need it; use it for storing clothing and accessories behind the door, organizing children's toys in the playroom, collecting books and magazines in the den, or displaying dried flowers and ferns in the living room. Perfect for families, apartments, college dorms, campers, RVs, etc.
